You don't seem yourself today, are you all right?
Come and sit with me a while.
I saw your face at supper; what's wrong?

[lowmood] Rough day?

I brought you something warm to drink, budge up.
[fear] I've got you, nothing's going to happen to you tonight.
[lonely] I'd like your company, if you'll have mine.
[lowmood] Come on, sit with me, you don't have to talk.

[grief] It's rotten, all of it, and you're allowed to say so.
[fear] Fear's just your body telling you you're alive, now breathe.

I've got a terrible joke and a biscuit, which do you want first?
[lowmood] Bad day? Mine too, let's be miserable together.
[lonely] You, me, and the worst game of cards ever played, tonight.

gloomy.li: I know, it's all awful, isn't it.
[despair] Some days I can't see the point either.
[grief] It doesn't get better, but it gets quieter.

[fear] We have walls and we have weapons; you're safe tonight.
[worry] Worrying won't change it, so tell me what it is.
[lowmood] You've not eaten; eat, then talk.

plain.li: I'm fine, really.
I don't know what's wrong with me lately.
Thanks, I didn't think anyone had noticed.
I just need a bit of time, I think.
It helps, having you here.

[grief,subject] I keep thinking about {SUBJECT}.
[grief] I can't stop thinking about it.
[grief] It doesn't feel real yet.
[despair] I don't see how it gets better.

[lonely] I feel like nobody would notice if I left.
[lonely] It's been a while since anyone asked.
[fear] I keep hearing them, every time the wind moves.
[fear] I'm scared all the time now, and I hate it.
[worry] I can't stop thinking about what could go wrong.
[worry] I just keep going over it, again and again.
[shame] I let everyone down.

[homesick] I miss my mother's voice.

[lowmood] Everything's just a bit much right now.
[samegroup] I didn't think anyone would notice.

[grief] I keep seeing their face.
[fear] I can't sleep, every noise wakes me.
[despair] I don't know how to keep going.
[shame] I don't know how to face everyone.

warm.li: You're kind to sit with me.
Thank you, it helps more than you know.

blunt.li: I don't want to talk about it.
[lowmood] It's nothing, just a bad week.

cheerful.li: And there I was, going for "mysterious".

plain.li: Take all the time you need.
You're not on your own, remember that.
Come and eat with us tonight, all right?
Find me if it gets bad again.
We'll get through this.
[grief] They wouldn't want you carrying this alone.
[grief] Sit with us tonight; you shouldn't be alone with it.
[fear] I'll take the watch tonight, you get some sleep.
[lonely] Sit with me at supper, I mean it.
[worry] Let's worry about it tomorrow, together.
[shame] We all make mistakes; it's what you do next that counts.
[homesick] This can be home too, give it time.

[despair] Tomorrow we'll find one good thing, I promise.
[otherrep:kind] You've been kind to all of us; let us be kind back.

warm.li: I'm always here, you know that.
You matter to us, never forget it.
I'll check on you in the morning.

blunt.li: Right, you're coming to supper, no arguments.

cheerful.li: Stick with me, I'm a professional at bad days.
And if all else fails, there's always pie.

gloomy.li: It's bad, but it'd be worse alone.
